title: SpatialCORE: Confidence-Aware Grounded Spatial Reasoning in Large Vision--Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38716v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have made remarkable progress across visual perception tasks, yet spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness, especially for questions that require reasoning over visual space. Recent spatial-reasoning methods incorporate generated grounding, where models predict bounding boxes, masks, or other localization outputs for task-relevant objects as part of their reasoning trace. translated_title: SpatialCORE：大型视觉-语言模型中置信度感知的接地空间推理
translated_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在各种视觉感知任务上取得了显著进展，但空间推理仍然是一个持续的弱点，尤其是对于需要在视觉空间上进行推理的问题。最近的空间推理方法引入了生成的接地（grounding），即模型在推理过程中为任务相关对象预测边界框、掩码或其他定位输出。然而，这些方法通常只优化最终答案的正确性，即使模型并未基于自信定位的任务相关对象进行推理，正确的答案也会得到奖励。我们提出了SpatialCORE（Spatially COnfident REasoning，空间自信推理），这是一个后训练框架，它将模型自身对生成接地的置信度转化为空间推理的学习信号。其核心思想是强化既准确又自信的接地，鼓励模型基于自信定位的对象进行推理。
tldr: SpatialCORE是一个后训练框架，通过将模型对生成接地的置信度转化为学习信号，强化既准确又自信的定位输出，从而提升大型视觉-语言模型的空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: SpatialCORE is a post-training framework that turns a model's own confidence in generated grounding into a learning signal, reinforcing grounding that is both accurate and confident to improve spatial reasoning in large vision-language models.
